findings.implication: A destroyed debugger target plus a one-worker target snapshot can produce an accepted result while the correlated old version remains restartable and the replacement version is unproved. If the ServiceWorker protocol is unavailable, truncated or ambiguous, the same OR can bypass the new refusal logic.
findings.required_fix: Make every accepted path prove authoritative old execution retirement and replacement execution, or provide and test an independently authoritative alternative for those exact facts. Add a harness-level refusal for destroyed target plus stopped/activated old version and absent replacement version, and for unavailable/ambiguous ServiceWorker evidence if no alternative exists.
